{{Top|leg}}
A '''stun charge''' was a bolt of electricity that could be emitted by both the [[CR-2 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|CR-2 heavy blaster pistol]] and the [[S-5 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|S-5 heavy blaster pistol]] in lieu of a standard [[Stun/Legends|stun function]]. The bolts were capable of stunning most living things.
